en.title: I believe every moment we go through has a reason, and each one can become an opportunity to make us stronger. We’ve become more determined because of it, and we’ll continue to focus on doing what we do best.

「我们经历的每一个瞬间都有它存在的理由，也会成为让我们变得更强大的机会。
我们因此变得更加坚定，以后也会继续做好自己的事。」
